verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at developer.ironcladapp.com (HTTP 200, titled 'Ironclad CLM API Documentation'). Doc pages are also served as raw markdown (.md) and point to a complete documentation index, and the many .md-suffixed reference URLs show the whole developer hub is agent-consumable. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown docs for agent use, and independent corroboration that agents use them well.
